what: Stage-2 Alpaca mirror still is not trade-identical after #14539 makes every CONFIG trade-shaping field equal. Three NON-config inputs to Coordinator.multi_account_execute differ between alpaca_live and alpaca_portfolio: (1) ALPACA_CASH_SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNTS (env) binds the T+1 sizing basis on alpaca_live only (accounts.yaml alpaca_live comment: the mirror measured negative venue_cash and would halt under `apply`); (2) cash vs margin buying power: alpaca_live is multiplier 1, $193.56 equity (diag broker_account_status 2026-09-30T05:36Z), so the whole-share cash wall refuses on live what the paper book sizes; (3) the venue shorting_enabled flag (false on live) -- moot for opens while both carry side_filter: long. Gate 2 reads the mirror's net-of-cost window as the demotion signal, so (1)-(2) mean it can include trades live could not size.
why_it_matters: B2 (operator 2026-09-21) requires IDENTICAL trades; a demotion signal read off trades the live book could not take is a different book's P&L.
